memberCardAdmin.description: Manage membership card status and check-in history
memberCardAdmin.title: QR membership cards

memberCardGuide.title: How to manage QR membership cards
memberCardGuide.description: Manage card status and visit history for your members. Use Member management to change roles or remove members.

cards.title: Find a card and change its status
cards.body: Each entry shows the member name, card number, status and check-in count. Members display their own QR code from their account membership-card settings.

steps.step1: On Cards, select All, Active, Suspended or Revoked to find a card.
steps.step2: Select Suspend to stop card use. Membership is retained.
steps.step3: On a suspended card, select Reactivate to restore use. Revoked cards cannot be reactivated here.

history.title: View a member’s check-ins
history.body: View check-ins from the last 30 days for the selected member.

steps.step1: Select Check-in history on the member’s card.
steps.step2: Check the time, method, location and staff member.
steps.step3: To view someone else, return to Cards and select Check-in history on another card.

team.title: Manage team statistics and locations
team.body: Teams show statistics and self-check-in locations to administrators and deputy administrators. These tabs are unavailable for organizations.

steps.step1: Open Check-in statistics for this month’s period, total check-ins, unique members and weekday counts.
steps.step2: In Locations, select Add location, enter a name and the automatic reservation completion setting, then create it.
steps.step3: Use the pencil to edit a location or the trash button to delete it.

errors.title: If loading fails
errors.body: A loading error caused by connectivity or permissions is shown separately from a successful empty result.

steps.step1: Read the error message and select Retry when available.
steps.step2: For permission problems, contact an administrator of the relevant team or organization.
